literature.headline_zh: 禽流感病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期禽流感病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 在 258 名暴露的参与者中,与未接触过的受试者相比,接触过的受试者对两种菌株表现出更高的 HI 几何平均滴度,接触过的受试者的血清转化率超过 89%,并且反应持续到第 202 天;引起的不良事件为轻度至中度,没有发生与 疫苗 相关的严重不良事件。 [10.1080/21645515.2026.2712791]
与 WHO 推荐的候选 疫苗 病毒 (CVV)、AL/39 相比,cHANA 在小鼠体内引发了更有效的交叉反应抗体反应和 T 细胞免疫。它还引发了针对异源 H9N2 病毒致命攻击的有效交叉保护,并显着降低了小鼠的肺部病毒载量。 [10.1080/22221751.2026.2713325]
1591 种 H9N2 病毒共鉴定出 52 种基因型,其中新定义基因型 48 种(G118~G163),其中 G57 和 G118 为主要流行基因型。贝叶斯分析揭示了 12 条迁徙路径,并确定华南地区是 传播 的主要中心。 [10.1080/22221751.2026.2713320]

神经病理学显示所有 4 只动物均患有淋巴组织细胞性至混合性中性粒细胞性脑膜脑炎,并伴有神经元坏死、神经吞噬、神经胶质细胞增殖、多灶性出血和血管周围套扎。免疫组织化学检测到神经元(3/3)、神经胶质细胞(3/3)和室管膜细胞(2/3)中的病毒核蛋白。新发现包括脉络丛炎(2/4)和脊髓炎(2/4)。全身性病变包括象海豹的多灶性坏死性心肌炎和海狮胎儿组织中检测到的高致病性禽流感病毒引起的多灶性坏死性胎盘炎。 [10.1177/03009858261465443]
澳大利亚已在五个州的 102 只野生海鸟中确认了 H5N1 病毒,并记录到 2025 年赫德岛估计有 13,359 只海鸟幼崽死亡,其中 5 种鸟类和几种海洋哺乳动物被确定为处于极端或高风险中。 [10.64628/aa.hknh69mya]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.headline_en: Recent Avian influenza A viruses literature
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Among 258 exposed participants, primed subjects showed higher HI geometric mean titers against both strains than unprimed subjects, with seroconversion rates exceeding 89% in primed groups and responses persisting to Day 202; solicited adverse events were mild to moderate and no vaccine-related serious adverse events occurred. [10.1080/21645515.2026.2712791]

Compared to the WHO-recommended candidate vaccine virus (CVV), AL/39, cHANA elicited more potent cross-reactive antibody responses and T cell immunity in mice. It also elicited effective cross-protection against lethal challenge with heterologous H9N2 virus and significantly reduced pulmonary viral loads of mice. [10.1080/22221751.2026.2713325]

A total of 52 genotypes were identified among 1,591 H9N2 viruses, including 48 newly defined genotypes (G118–G163), with G57 and G118 as the main epidemic genotypes. Bayesian analysis revealed 12 migration paths and identified South China as the main transmission centre. [10.1080/22221751.2026.2713320]

Neuropathology revealed lymphohistiocytic to mixed neutrophilic meningoencephalitis with neuronal necrosis, neuronophagia, glial cell proliferation, multifocal hemorrhage, and perivascular cuffing in all 4 animals. [10.1177/03009858261465443]

Australia has confirmed H5N1 in 102 wild seabirds across five states and recorded an estimated 13,359 pup deaths at Heard Island in 2025, with five bird species and several marine mammals identified as at extreme or high risk. [10.64628/aa.hknh69mya]

news.headline_zh: 禽流感病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期禽流感病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: H5N1 禽流感(H5 禽流感)已在几种流浪迁徙海鸟中得到证实。新南威尔士州第一产业部报道了这一事件。 [news-0ab3fff950cdb3e3]

papers.title: Heterologous prime-boost vaccination against H5 avian influenza: Safety and immunogenicity of a MF59-adjuvanted, cell-culture derived H5N6 vaccine.
papers.abstract: With increasing H5 avian influenza cases reported globally and the potential for pandemic emergence, induction of cross-reactive antibody responses may represent an important attribute of an effective vaccine. This phase 2 extension study evaluated immunogenicity and safety of MF59-adjuvanted, cell culture-derived H5N6 vaccine (aH5N6c) in adults primed with MF59-adjuvanted, cell culture-derived H5N1 vaccine (aH5N1c) and in unprimed adults. Adults previously primed with two doses of aH5N1c in the parent study V89_18 were randomized to receive two aH5N6c doses (Group 1) or one aH5N6c and one placebo (Group 2) 3 weeks apart. Unprimed adults received two aH5N6c doses (Group 3). Immunogenicity was assessed by hemagglutination inhibition (HI) and microneutralization (MN) assays against the priming (H5N1) and booster (H5N6) strains on Days 1, 8, 22, 43, and 202. Among 258 exposed participants, primed subjects (Groups 1 and 2) showed higher HI geometric mean titers against both strains than unprimed (Group 3) subjects, with MN responses similarly enhanced. Heterologous H5N1 responses were robust in primed subjects (Day 43 HI GMTs: 333-343; seroconversion rates >89%) but minimal in unprimed subjects, with responses persisting to Day 202. Solicited adverse events were mild or moderate, comparable between groups, and consistent with other MF59-adjuvanted pandemic vaccines; no vaccine-related serious adverse events occurred. Heterologous H5N6 booster vaccination in H5N1-primed adults elicited strong cross-reactive immunity against the priming strain, demonstrating long-lasting immune memory for at least 6 y and supporting heterologous prime-boost strategies for pandemic preparedness against emerging H5 outbreaks.

papers.title: A bivalent inactivated influenza vaccine incorporating epitope-optimized surface proteins confers cross-protective immunity against H9N2 influenza virus.
papers.abstract: Abstract The H9N2 avian influenza virus (AIV) has caused substantial economic losses to the global poultry industry and poses a zoonotic threat to humans. Vaccination constitutes a pivotal strategy for the prevention and control of H9N2 AIVs. However, the ongoing antigenic evolution of the virus poses a persistent challenge to the protective efficacy of existing vaccines. Therefore, the development of a broadly protective H9N2 influenza vaccine capable of eliciting cross-reactive immune responses is crucial for mitigating both the disease burden and the risk of pandemics. Here, we developed a bivalent chimeric inactivated vaccine, designated cHANA, by combining two individually rescued chimeric inactivated viruses, cHANA1 and cHANA2. Each recombinant virus carries one set of Epigraph-designed HA and NA immunogens, and the two sets were computationally optimized from global H9N2 HA and NA sequence datasets to complement each other in epitope coverage across the H9N2 viral population. Compared to the WHO-recommended candidate vaccine virus (CVV), AL/39, cHANA elicited more potent cross-reactive antibody responses and T cell immunity in mice. Furthermore, it elicited effective cross-protection against lethal challenge with heterologous H9N2 virus and significantly reduced pulmonary viral loads of mice. By conferring broad protective immunity, this vaccine represents a promising universal candidate for controlling H9N2 outbreaks.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决 H9N2 禽流感 病毒的持续抗原 进化 带来的挑战,该挑战破坏了现有 疫苗 的有效性。H9N2 禽流感 病毒给全球家禽业造成了重大经济损失,并对人类构成人畜共患威胁。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一种二价嵌合灭活病毒 疫苗,命名为 cHANA,是通过结合两种单独拯救的嵌合灭活病毒 cHANA1 和 cHANA2 开发的。该研究评估了 疫苗 在小鼠中对抗异源 H9N2 病毒致死攻击的功效。
elements_zh.methods: 疫苗 是通过计算优化来自全球 H9N2 序列数据集的 HA 和 NA 免疫原而构建的。每种重组病毒都携带一组 Epigraph 设计的 HA 和 NA 免疫原,这两组免疫原经过优化,可在 H9N2 病毒群体的表位覆盖范围上相互补充。
elements_zh.main_results: 与 WHO 推荐的候选 疫苗 病毒 (CVV)、AL/39 相比,cHANA 在小鼠体内引发了更有效的交叉反应抗体反应和 T 细胞免疫。它还引发了针对异源 H9N2 病毒致命攻击的有效交叉保护,并显着降低了小鼠的肺部病毒载量。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 结果表明,chHANA 疫苗 增强了针对 H9N2 流感病毒的交叉反应免疫力,这是开发针对这种不断进化的病原体的广泛保护性 疫苗 的新方法。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,chHANA 可能是一种有前途的通用 疫苗 候选药物,用于控制 H9N2 暴发,通过降低人畜共患 传播 的风险,为家禽业和公共卫生带来潜在益处。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于小鼠模型,结果可能无法完全转化为人类。然而,证据是强有力的,因为它直接将 疫苗 的功效与 WHO 推荐的候选药物进行比较,并在相关动物模型中证明了交叉保护。

papers.title: Genetic evolution, phylodynamics, geographic spread of H9N2 avian influenza viruses in China from 2014 to 2025: an increasing potential zoonotic risk.
papers.abstract: Subtype H9N2 of the avian influenza virus (AIV) poses a growing threat to the poultry industry and public health. However, since 2014, there has been no systematic study of its genetic evolution, genotype, spatial dynamics, and pathogenicity in China. Therefore, we performed a large-scale sequence analysis of the genome of Chinese H9N2 viruses from 2014 to 2025 using public databases and laboratory isolates. We identified 52 different genotypes in 1,591 H9N2 viruses, including 4 previously recognized genotypes (G6, G57, G58, and G68) and 48 newly defined genotypes (G118-G163) in this study. G57 and G118 were the main epidemic genotypes in China from 2014 to 2025. Bayesian phylogeographic analysis showed that there were 12 obvious migration paths for the spread of H9N2 AIVs in China from 2017 to 2022. In particular, the South China region was the main transmission centre. H9N2 AIV continues to circulate in chickens and ducks in China and spreads to other hosts. The H9N2 AIVs with the G57 and G118 genotypes could effectively replicate in MDCK, CEF, A549, and HBE cells with titres of 0.97-8.5 lgTCID 50 /mL. The G57 and G118 genotypes H9N2 viruses preferentially bound to α-2,6-linked sialic acid glycopolymers (human receptors), and effectively replicate in multiple organs of mice and chickens and cause pathological changes in the lungs. Thus, it is necessary to strengthen the monitoring and prevention of H9N2 AIVs in China.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Subtype H9N2 avian influenza virus (AIV) poses a growing threat to poultry and public health, yet systematic analyses of its genetic evolution, genotype dynamics, spatial spread, and pathogenicity in China since 2014 were lacking.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study performed a large-scale sequence analysis of H9N2 AIV genomes from China spanning 2014 to 2025, integrating public databases and laboratory isolates.
analysis.methods: Genome sequences were retrieved and analyzed to define genotypes and perform Bayesian phylogeographic analysis to reconstruct migration paths and transmission centres.
analysis.main_results: A total of 52 genotypes were identified among 1,591 H9N2 viruses, including 48 newly defined genotypes (G118–G163), with G57 and G118 as the main epidemic genotypes. Bayesian analysis revealed 12 migration paths and identified South China as the main transmission centre.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the predominance of G57 and G118 genotypes and their expanded host range as evidence of increasing zoonotic potential, highlighting the need for enhanced surveillance.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings support targeted surveillance and prevention strategies for H9N2 AIV in China, particularly in South China, to mitigate zoonotic and poultry industry risks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on publicly available sequences and laboratory isolates, which may underrepresent geographic and temporal diversity, limiting generalisability and introducing sampling bias.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed 1,591 H9N2 avian influenza virus genomes from China (2014–2025) to characterize genetic evolution, genotype diversity, and spatial spread. Fifty-two genotypes were identified, including 48 newly defined (G118–G163), with G57 and G118 dominating circulation. Bayesian phylogeographic analysis revealed 12 migration paths and designated South China as the principal transmission hub. The authors highlight the increasing zoonotic potential of G57 and G118 genotypes, which showed expanded host range and human receptor binding affinity. The study underscores the need for strengthened surveillance and prevention measures in China, particularly in high-risk regions.

Thursday, August 06, 2026 Australia: H5 Positive Bird Count Rises (n=123) - Victoria Reports 1st Land bird Infection & Investigating Dead Seal #19,280 While not unexpected, overnight CSIRO has reported the first Australian land bird - a Magpie from Victoria - has been confirmed infected with HPAI H5N1. This is their first non-seabird report since the virus was confirmed in June. 6 August 2026 Attributable to Acting Australian Chief Veterinary Officer, Dr Sam Hamilton: Testing at CSIRO’s Australian Centre for Disease Preparedness (ACDP) has confirmed a further 16 positive detections in Victoria, 14 greater crested terns, one silver gull and one magpie. Update: FLI Detects Novel Orthobunyavirus in German/Swiss Dairy Cattle Biting Midge after blood meal #19,279 Four days ago we looked at a statement from the Swiss FSVO (Federal Office for Food Safety and Veterinary Affairs) on their Investigation into an Unidentified Bovine Disease which produced fevers, diarrhea, and substantial milk drop in dairy cows. Since then, Germany's FLI (Friedrich Loeffler Institute) has announced the results of their own investigation, which had discovered high levels of a novel orthobunyavirus of the Simbu serogroup present in affected cattle. Orthobunyaviruses are a large and growing family `arboviruses' - viruses carried and spread by biting insects (mosquitoes, ticks & midges) - that mostly infect animals, but are sometimes zoonotic. The virus in question is reportedly similar to viruses that are found in Africa, Asia, and Australia. These types of viruses are not usually zoonotic, but additional studies will be needed to determine its actual risk. I've posted the FLI press release below: FLI detects a new orthobunyavirus of the Simbu serogroup (“Shamonda-like”) in cattle in Germany 08/03/2026 Press Releases The Friedrich-Loeffler-Institut (FLI) has detected a previously uncharacterised orthobunyavirus of the Simbu serogroup in samples from affected cattle in southern Germany. Following the first appearance of the Schmallenberg virus in 2011, this once again provides reliable evidence that a new virus from this group has been introduced into Germany. The newly detected virus shows the closest relationship to the Shamonda virus in all three segments. Viruses of the Simbu serogroup are found primarily in Africa, Asia and Australia. Like bluetongue virus and Schmallenberg virus, they are transmitted by blood-sucking midges of the genus Culicoides. The animals most commonly infected are ruminants, particularly cattle, sheep and goats. Cases were first detected in cattle in Switzerland, France and southern Germany, particularly in Baden-Württemberg. The affected animals showed signs of fever and diarrhoea. In dairy cows, a decline in milk yield – in some cases significant – was also observed. These clinical signs have been observed in numerous animals and herds since July. The clinical signs were initially consistent with infection by the Schmallenberg virus. However, tests for Schmallenberg virus, as well as for other known pathogens such as bluetongue virus or epizootic haemorrhagic disease virus, proved negative. Samples from four affected cattle herds were submitted to the FLI by the local state veterinary laboratory (Chemisches und Veterinäruntersuchungsamt Freiburg). Within 48 hours, the samples had been analysed and the pathogen further characterised. A Pan-Simbuvirus PCR revealed clear positive signals in several serum and blood samples from different farms, with Ct values of up to around 20. This indicates high viral loads at the time of sampling. Further PCR tests for viruses in this group also yielded positive results. Whole-genome sequencing revealed that all three genome segments showed the highest sequence similarity to Shamonda viruses (at the amino acid level: S: 99 %; M: 95 %; L: 97 %). Whilst the S and L segments are also closely related to Schmallenberg virus, the M segment – which is particularly relevant for antigenicity and the immune response – shows a significantly lower degree of similarity (<50 %). The final taxonomic classification of the virus is currently pending. Infections with viruses of the Simbu serogroup generally lead to a brief period of viraemia and only mild to moderate clinical signs in adult animals. Of particular significance, however, is the potential transmission to the foetus during pregnancy. Depending on the timing of the infection, abortions, stillbirths and severe congenital malformations may occur. In the case of e Schmallenberg virus, sheep were particularly affected by this. In some flocks, malformation was observed in up to 50 % of the offspring. In cattle, foetal malformations were less pronounced. As regards the newly identified ‘Shamonda-like’ virus, it is not yet possible to assess whether, and to what extent, infections in pregnant animals may lead to malformation in the foetuses. Abortions, stillbirths and malformed calves or lambs from herds that may be affected should therefore be examined. Depending on the weather, the midge season in Germany lasts until around the end of November. Midge activity is usually at its peak between July and October. Given the generally efficient transmission by midges, a further and potentially rapid spread of the virus within susceptible herds is therefore anticipated. Viruses of the Simbu serogroup are not generally considered to be zoonotic agents and, based on current knowledge, do not pose a significant risk of infection to humans. However, in the case of newly emerging and insufficiently characterised viruses in this group, their potential zoonotic risk should be investigated as a precautionary measure and closely monitored as the situation develops. The FLI is giving high priority to the complete characterisation of the pathogen, the epidemiological tracing of cases, and the adaptation and development of specific diagnostic methods. “Following the 2011 Schmallenberg virus outbreak, an exotic orthobunyavirus has once again been introduced into Central Europe. Investigations over the coming weeks will reveal how rapidly it is spreading, which animal species are particularly affected, and what clinical consequences can be expected. Of crucial importance is the question of whether infections during pregnancy lead to foetal malformation,” said Prof. Dr. Martin Beer, Vice-President of the Friedrich-Loeffler-Institut. In principle, vaccines can be developed against orthobunyaviruses. However, this requires sufficient lead time. The necessity and urgency of vaccine development will depend largely on the clinical and, in particular, reproductive significance of the newly introduced virus. Precursors to the 2009 H1N1 pandemic virus, which emerged from North American pigs, appear to have been circulating for at least a decade before it began its world tour. It has been estimated that ancestral strains of COVID-19 may have been circulating for 4 to 7 decades in bats before spilling over into humans. We've been watching HPAI H5Nx for 3 decades, and while it continues to improve its game, it has yet to adapt well enough to human physiology to spread efficiently. The same could be said for many other novel viruses, including both swine and avian flu, henipaviruses like Nipah, scores of other coronaviruses, and of course `Disease X'; the placeholder for those threats yet to be discovered. One of the `usual suspects' we keep coming back to is LPAI H9N2, which is ubiquitous in Asian poultry, has spread to both Africa and the Middle East, and just recently turned up in Europe. While roughly 200 human (mostly mild) cases have been reported over the past 30 years - mostly from China - recently we've seen an uptick in cases, with 9 reported in China/Hong Kong over the past 2 months (see WHO WPRO Reporting 4 More H9N2 Cases on Chinese Mainland). The Asian Y280/G57 lineages have shown increasing signs of mammalian adaptation (see EM&I: Enhanced Replication of a Contemporary Avian Influenza A H9N2 Virus in Human Respiratory Organoids)), while the African and Middle Eastern Lineages (mostly European G1-like) are older and less evolved. Last summer, in Nature: Genetic diversity of H9N2 avian influenza viruses in poultry across China and implications for zoonotic transmission, researchers reported rising prevalence of key mutations associated with increased infectivity and pathogenicity in mammals. Despite being clearly zoonotic - LPAI H9N2 is considered a `non-reportable' disease in poultry or wild birds by WOAH (see Terrestrial Animal Code). As a result, there are huge gaps in surveillance and reporting around the world. Complicating matters, China's attempts to control LPAI H9N2 through vaccines have been less than successful. But based on the frequency of Chinese studies published on LPAI H9 over the past couple of years, they quite obviously take its threat seriously. Which suggests we should, as well. papers.title: Neuropathology, novel tissue tropism, and evidence of vertical transmission in South American pinnipeds naturally infected with high pathogenicity avian influenza H5N1 virus in Argentina.
papers.abstract: In 2023, high pathogenicity avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 outbreaks caused mass mortality events affecting pinnipeds throughout South America. Here, we present the clinical, pathological, immunohistochemical, and molecular findings associated with HPAI H5N1 infection in 3 South American sea lions ( Otaria flavescens ) and 1 southern elephant seal ( Mirounga leonina ) stranded during the outbreak in Chubut, Argentina. Neurological signs were observed in 2 sea lions, with 1 also exhibiting respiratory distress. Necropsies were conducted on all 4 animals. Neuropathology revealed mild-to-severe lymphohistiocytic (2/4) to mixed neutrophilic (2/4) meningoencephalitis with neuronal necrosis, neuronophagia, glial cell proliferation, multifocal hemorrhage, and perivascular cuffing in all animals. Novel findings for HPAI H5N1-infected pinnipeds included choroid plexitis (2/4) and myelitis (2/4). Immunohistochemistry for viral nucleoprotein was positive in 3 of 4 animals and involved neurons (3/3), glial cells (3/3), and ependymal cells (2/3). Viral-related systemic findings included multifocal necrotizing myocarditis in the elephant seal and multifocal necrotizing placentitis in a sea lion, with HPAI virus detected within fetal tissues. Pulmonary lesions were minimal and were limited to multifocal necrosis of bronchial glands in 1 sea lion. HPAI H5 clade 2.3.4.4b virus was confirmed by polymerase chain reaction and sequencing in all animals. These findings indicate a predominance of central nervous system involvement in HPAI H5N1-infected pinnipeds and expand the recognized spectrum of virus-associated lesions, identifying novel tissue tropisms and transmission routes.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the neuropathology, tissue tropism, and transmission of high pathogenicity avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 in South American pinnipeds during a 2023 outbreak in Argentina. Necropsies of 3 South American sea lions and 1 southern elephant seal revealed consistent central nervous system involvement, including meningoencephalitis, neuronal necrosis, and glial cell proliferation, alongside novel findings such as choroid plexitis and myelitis. Viral nucleoprotein was detected in neurons, glial cells, and ependymal cells via immunohistochemistry. Systemic lesions included myocarditis and placentitis, with evidence of vertical transmission in one case. The authors conclude that HPAI H5N1 in pinnipeds exhibits a predominance of neurological involvement and previously unrecognized tissue tropisms. The findings emphasize the need for targeted surveillance and diagnostic strategies in marine mammals to inform conservation and public health measures.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 这项研究需要解决2023年高致病性禽流感 (HPAI) H5N1 暴发对南美鳍足类动物的严重影响,该影响导致了大规模的死亡率事件。作者旨在描述自然感染的鳍足类 HPAI H5N1 感染的临床、病理和分子特征,以填补有关组织向性和 传播 途径的知识空白。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究检查了在阿根廷丘布特省 HPAI H5N1 暴发 期间搁浅的 4 只鳍足类动物,其中包括 3 只南美海狮 (Otaria flavescens) 和 1 只南象海豹 (Mirounga leonina)。对所有动物进行尸检以评估临床和病理结果。
elements_zh.methods: 使用聚合酶链式反应和测序在所有动物中证实了 HPAI H5 clade 2.3.4.4b 病毒感染。神经病理学检查包括脑膜脑炎、神经元坏死、神经胶质细胞增殖、出血和血管周围套扎的评估。
elements_zh.main_results: 神经病理学显示所有 4 只动物均患有淋巴组织细胞性至混合性中性粒细胞性脑膜脑炎,并伴有神经元坏死、神经吞噬、神经胶质细胞增殖、多灶性出血和血管周围套扎。免疫组织化学检测到神经元(3/3)、神经胶质细胞(3/3)和室管膜细胞(2/3)中的病毒核蛋白。新发现包括脉络丛炎(2/4)和脊髓炎(2/4)。全身性病变包括象海豹的多灶性坏死性心肌炎和海狮胎儿组织中检测到的高致病性禽流感病毒引起的多灶性坏死性胎盘炎。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,HPAI H5N1 感染的鳍足类动物主要受累于中枢神经系统,并扩大了病毒相关病变的认识范围。确定了新的组织向性和 传播 途径,包括垂直 传播。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究强调需要增强海洋哺乳动物 HPAI H5N1 的 监测 和诊断方法,以便为保护策略提供信息并评估人畜共患风险。它强调了监测受影响物种的神经和生殖系统参与情况的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 样本量小(n = 4)和缺乏对照动物限制了因果推论的普遍性和强度。该研究依赖于尸检,可能无法捕获早期或亚临床感染,并且研究结果特定于单个 暴发 位置。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 这项研究需要解决2023年高致病性禽流感 (HPAI) H5N1 暴发对南美鳍足类动物的严重影响,该影响导致了大规模的死亡率事件。作者旨在描述自然感染的鳍足类 HPAI H5N1 感染的临床、病理和分子特征,以填补有关组织向性和 传播 途径的知识空白。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究检查了在阿根廷丘布特省 HPAI H5N1 暴发 期间搁浅的 4 只鳍足类动物,其中包括 3 只南美海狮 (Otaria flavescens) 和 1 只南象海豹 (Mirounga leonina)。对所有动物进行尸检以评估临床和病理结果。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用聚合酶链式反应和测序在所有动物中证实了 HPAI H5 clade 2.3.4.4b 病毒感染。神经病理学检查包括脑膜脑炎、神经元坏死、神经胶质细胞增殖、出血和血管周围套扎的评估。
analysis_zh.main_results: 神经病理学显示所有 4 只动物均患有淋巴组织细胞性至混合性中性粒细胞性脑膜脑炎,并伴有神经元坏死、神经吞噬、神经胶质细胞增殖、多灶性出血和血管周围套扎。免疫组织化学检测到神经元(3/3)、神经胶质细胞(3/3)和室管膜细胞(2/3)中的病毒核蛋白。新发现包括脉络丛炎(2/4)和脊髓炎(2/4)。全身性病变包括象海豹的多灶性坏死性心肌炎和海狮胎儿组织中检测到的高致病性禽流感病毒引起的多灶性坏死性胎盘炎。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,HPAI H5N1 感染的鳍足类动物主要受累于中枢神经系统,并扩大了病毒相关病变的认识范围。确定了新的组织向性和 传播 途径,包括垂直 传播。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究强调需要增强海洋哺乳动物 HPAI H5N1 的 监测 和诊断方法,以便为保护策略提供信息并评估人畜共患风险。它强调了监测受影响物种的神经和生殖系统参与情况的重要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 样本量小(n = 4)和缺乏对照动物限制了因果推论的普遍性和强度。该研究依赖于尸检,可能无法捕获早期或亚临床感染,并且研究结果特定于单个 暴发 位置。

papers.title: D347G in PA is critical for the pathogenicity of H9N2 avian influenza A virus in mice.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Some subtypes of avian influenza A viruses (IAVs) have been associated with human infections (e.g. H3N8, H5Ny, H7Ny, H9N2, and H10Ny), and the ability of these viruses to cause zoonotic infections further increases the public health risk of avian IAVs. Among them, H9N2 virus is one of particular importance, both in its own right and as a contributor of internal gene segments to other emerging zoonotic avian IAVs. In recent years, an increasing number of H9N2 strains have been observed to be highly pathogenic in mice without prior adaptation. In this study, we found that a naturally occurring H9N2 isolate, A/chicken/Jiangxi/198/2019 (JX198), is lethal in mice. To investigate the molecular basis for the high virulence of JX198 in mice, a series of reassortants and mutants were generated and tested. We found that the PA, especially D347G mutation in PA, is responsible for the increased pathogenicity of JX198 in mice. Notably, D347G in PA of JX198 significantly alters the polymerase activity, vRNA production, and plaque-formation. Thus, our data demonstrate that a novel molecular marker, D347G in PA, determines the virulence of H9N2 in mice, posing a potential risk of H9N2 with D347G in PA for public health and highlighting the significance of continuing surveillance of H9N2 field strains.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate the molecular basis for the high virulence of a naturally occurring H9N2 isolate in mice, as some avian influenza A virus subtypes have been associated with human infections and zoonotic transmission, increasing public health risks.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved generating and testing a series of reassortants and mutants of the H9N2 virus to determine the molecular factors contributing to its high pathogenicity in mice. The research was conducted using a mouse model with the H9N2 isolate A/chicken/Jiangxi/198/2019 (JX198).
analysis.methods: To explore the virulence mechanisms, the researchers created reassortants and mutants of JX198 and evaluated their effects on polymerase activity, vRNA production, and plaque formation in mice.
analysis.main_results: The study found that the PA gene, particularly the D347G mutation, is responsible for the increased pathogenicity of JX198 in mice. The D347G mutation significantly altered polymerase activity, vRNA production, and plaque formation.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted their findings to show that the D347G mutation in the PA gene of H9N2 viruses is a novel molecular marker that determines virulence in mice, indicating a potential public health risk.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results highlight the importance of continued surveillance of H9N2 field strains, as the D347G mutation in PA may contribute to increased virulence and zoonotic potential.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a mouse model and does not account for human infection dynamics, but the evidence is strong due to the direct experimental manipulation and clear results on virulence factors.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the molecular basis of high virulence in H9N2 avian influenza A virus in mice. The researchers identified the D347G mutation in the PA gene as critical for increased pathogenicity, as it alters polymerase activity, vRNA production, and plaque formation. The findings suggest that this mutation may pose a public health risk and emphasize the need for continued surveillance of H9N2 field strains. The study uses a mouse model and experimental reassortants to explore virulence mechanisms, providing strong evidence for the role of the PA gene in determining pathogenicity. However, the results are specific to the mouse model and do not directly translate to human infections. The study contributes to understanding the genetic factors that influence the zoonotic potential of avian influenza viruses.

papers.title_zh: PA 中的 D347G 对于 H9N2 禽流感 A 病毒对小鼠的致病性至关重要。
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Some subtypes of avian influenza A viruses (IAVs) have been associated with human infections (e.g. H3N8, H5Ny, H7Ny, H9N2, and H10Ny), and the ability of these viruses to cause zoonotic infections further increases the public health risk of avian IAVs. Among them, H9N2 virus is one of particular importance, both in its own right and as a contributor of internal gene segments to other emerging zoonotic avian IAVs. In recent years, an increasing number of H9N2 strains have been observed to be highly pathogenic in mice without prior adaptation. In this study, we found that a naturally occurring H9N2 isolate, A/chicken/Jiangxi/198/2019 (JX198), is lethal in mice. To investigate the molecular basis for the high virulence of JX198 in mice, a series of reassortants and mutants were generated and tested. We found that the PA, especially D347G mutation in PA, is responsible for the increased pathogenicity of JX198 in mice. Notably, D347G in PA of JX198 significantly alters the polymerase activity, vRNA production, and plaque-formation. Thus, our data demonstrate that a novel molecular marker, D347G in PA, determines the virulence of H9N2 in mice, posing a potential risk of H9N2 with D347G in PA for public health and highlighting the significance of continuing surveillance of H9N2 field strains.

papers.title: Subclass switching enhances protective efficacy of a non-neutralizing H7N9 avian influenza antibody.
papers.abstract: Non-neutralizing antibodies contribute to protection against the H7N9 subtype avian influenza virus through Fc effector functions. Antibody subclass plays a critical role in determining binding affinity to Fc receptors (FcR) and downstream Fc effector functions. In this study, to assess whether antibody subclass switching can enhance antibody protective efficacy, subclass of a non-neutralizing monoclonal antibody (mAb) against the hemagglutinin of H7N9 virus was switched from IgG1 to IgG2a, and their activity and protective efficacy were assessed. Subclass switching caused no significant changes in antigen binding, hemagglutination-inhibition and virus neutralizing activities of the antibody. The hybridoma-derived mAb conferred no protection against H7N9 virus infection. Interestingly, both IgG2a and IgG1 antibodies produced in CHO cells provided full protection against mortality caused by a sublethal H7N9 virus challenge. Upon lethal challenge, IgG2a antibody conferred 70% protection, whereas its IgG1 counterpart only provided 30% protection. However, both antibodies did not decrease virus loads in mouse lungs. Moreover, compared to the IgG1 antibody, affinity of the subclass-switched IgG2a antibody to FcR was significantly increased, as evidenced by enhanced binding of the antibody to recombinant murine FcγRI and to FcRs on murine macrophages. Our findings highlighted a benefit of subclass-engineering to antibody modification and development of therapeutic antibodies.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed whether subclass switching of a non-neutralizing monoclonal antibody (mAb) against H7N9 avian influenza virus could enhance its protective efficacy through Fc effector functions, given that antibody subclass influences Fc receptor binding and downstream immune responses.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study assessed the activity and protective efficacy of a non-neutralizing mAb against H7N9 hemagglutinin after switching its subclass from IgG1 to IgG2a, using hybridoma-derived and CHO cell-produced antibodies in mouse models challenged with H7N9 virus.
analysis.methods: The subclass of a non-neutralizing mAb against H7N9 hemagglutinin was switched from IgG1 to IgG2a, and antigen binding, hemagglutination-inhibition, virus neutralizing activities, Fc receptor binding affinity, and protective efficacy were evaluated in mouse challenge models.
analysis.main_results: Subclass switching did not alter antigen binding, hemagglutination-inhibition, or virus neutralizing activities, but IgG2a showed significantly higher affinity to FcγRI and murine macrophage FcRs compared to IgG1. In sublethal challenge, both IgG1 and IgG2a provided full protection, whereas in lethal challenge, IgG2a conferred 70% protection versus 30% for IgG1. Neither antibody reduced virus loads in mouse lungs.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that subclass switching enhanced protective efficacy by improving Fc receptor engagement without altering antigen-binding or neutralizing activity, highlighting a novel strategy for therapeutic antibody engineering against H7N9.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings suggest that subclass engineering of therapeutic antibodies could improve clinical outcomes for H7N9 infections by enhancing Fc-mediated protection, informing future vaccine and therapeutic development strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was limited to mouse models and did not evaluate virus load reduction or long-term protection, which constrains generalizability to human infections; the evidence strength is moderate due to the absence of human data and mechanistic depth.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated whether switching the subclass of a non-neutralizing monoclonal antibody (mAb) against H7N9 avian influenza virus from IgG1 to IgG2a could enhance its protective efficacy. The authors found that subclass switching did not alter antigen binding, hemagglutination-inhibition, or virus neutralizing activities but significantly increased Fc receptor binding affinity. In mouse challenge models, both IgG1 and IgG2a provided full protection against sublethal H7N9 infection, while IgG2a conferred 70% protection compared to 30% for IgG1 in lethal challenge. Neither antibody reduced virus loads in lungs. The authors concluded that subclass engineering enhances Fc-mediated protection without compromising antigen specificity, offering a novel approach for therapeutic antibody development against H7N9.

analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study assessed the activity and protective efficacy of a non-neutralizing mAb against H7N9 hemagglutinin after switching its subclass from IgG1 to IgG2a, using hybridoma-derived and CHO cell-produced antibodies in mouse models challenged with H7N9 virus.
analysis_en.methods: The subclass of a non-neutralizing mAb against H7N9 hemagglutinin was switched from IgG1 to IgG2a, and antigen binding, hemagglutination-inhibition, virus neutralizing activities, Fc receptor binding affinity, and protective efficacy were evaluated in mouse challenge models.
analysis_en.main_results: Subclass switching did not alter antigen binding, hemagglutination-inhibition, or virus neutralizing activities, but IgG2a showed significantly higher affinity to FcγRI and murine macrophage FcRs compared to IgG1. In sublethal challenge, both IgG1 and IgG2a provided full protection, whereas in lethal challenge, IgG2a conferred 70% protection versus 30% for IgG1. Neither antibody reduced virus loads in mouse lungs.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that subclass switching enhanced protective efficacy by improving Fc receptor engagement without altering antigen-binding or neutralizing activity, highlighting a novel strategy for therapeutic antibody engineering against H7N9.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings suggest that subclass engineering of therapeutic antibodies could improve clinical outcomes for H7N9 infections by enhancing Fc-mediated protection, informing future vaccine and therapeutic development strategies.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was limited to mouse models and did not evaluate virus load reduction or long-term protection, which constrains generalizability to human infections; the evidence strength is moderate due to the absence of human data and mechanistic depth.

papers.title_zh: 亚类转换增强非中和性 H7N9 禽流感 抗体的保护功效。
papers.source_body_en: Non-neutralizing antibodies contribute to protection against the H7N9 subtype avian influenza virus through Fc effector functions. Antibody subclass plays a critical role in determining binding affinity to Fc receptors (FcR) and downstream Fc effector functions. In this study, to assess whether antibody subclass switching can enhance antibody protective efficacy, subclass of a non-neutralizing monoclonal antibody (mAb) against the hemagglutinin of H7N9 virus was switched from IgG1 to IgG2a, and their activity and protective efficacy were assessed. Subclass switching caused no significant changes in antigen binding, hemagglutination-inhibition and virus neutralizing activities of the antibody. The hybridoma-derived mAb conferred no protection against H7N9 virus infection. Interestingly, both IgG2a and IgG1 antibodies produced in CHO cells provided full protection against mortality caused by a sublethal H7N9 virus challenge. Upon lethal challenge, IgG2a antibody conferred 70% protection, whereas its IgG1 counterpart only provided 30% protection. However, both antibodies did not decrease virus loads in mouse lungs. Moreover, compared to the IgG1 antibody, affinity of the subclass-switched IgG2a antibody to FcR was significantly increased, as evidenced by enhanced binding of the antibody to recombinant murine FcγRI and to FcRs on murine macrophages. Our findings highlighted a benefit of subclass-engineering to antibody modification and development of therapeutic antibodies.

papers.title: A One-Shot Multivalent Live-Attenuated Candidate Influenza Vaccine against Divergent Zoonotic H5N1 Clades
papers.abstract: Abstract The continued emergence of genetically diverse high pathogenicity avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 viruses with zoonotic potential highlights the urgent need for developing vaccines capable of providing broad protection against multiple circulating clades. Here, we developed a one-shot, multivalent, live-attenuated influenza vaccine (LAIV) based on the temperature-sensitive (ts), cold-adapted (ca), and attenuated ( att ) influenza A/Ann Arbor/6/1960 master donor virus (MDV) that incorporates the hemagglutinin (HA) and neuraminidase (NA) glycoproteins from representative clades 2.3.4.4b (A/Louisiana/12/2024), 2.3.2.1a (A/Victoria/149/2024), and 2.3.2.1e (A/Cambodia/2302009/2023) H5N1 viruses. A single intranasal (IN) immunization of C57BL/6 mice with the multivalent LAIV elicited robust humoral immune responses, with immune sera exhibiting broad cross-reactivity against antigens from all three H5N1 clades included in the vaccine. Following homologous viral challenge, vaccinated C57BL/6 mice were completely protected from disease, demonstrating the immunogenicity and protective efficacy of the multivalent LAIV. By simultaneously targeting antigenically distinct H5N1 lineages with pandemic potential, this strategy expands antigenic coverage within a single LAIV to confirm pan-H5N1 protection. Together, these findings support the development and implementation of this multivalent LAIV as a broadly protective pan-H5N1 LAIV for pandemic preparedness. Significance The increasing genetic diversity of zoonotic H5N1 viruses complicates vaccine design. We developed a multivalent live-attenuated influenza vaccine (LAIV) based on the temperature-sensitive, cold-adapted, and attenuated ( ts , ca , att ) master donor virus (MDV) influenza A/Ann Arbor/6/1960 backbone that expresses the hemagglutinin (HA) and neuraminidase (NA) glycoproteins of H5N1 clades 2.3.4.4b, 2.3.2.1a, and 2.3.2.1e. A single intranasal (IN) immunization with the multivalent LAIV induced broadly cross-reactive neutralizing antibody (NAb) responses and protected experimental vaccinated animals against homologous lethal viral challenge, demonstrating the feasibility of the multivalent LAIV to protect against H5N1 clades of highest concern to humans. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of developing and implementing this multivalent LAIV as a broad protective pan-H5N1 LAIV against divergent H5N1 viruses for human use.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the urgent public-health need for vaccines that can protect against genetically diverse zoonotic H5N1 influenza viruses, which continue to emerge in multiple clades and pose pandemic risk.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The authors developed a multivalent live-attenuated influenza vaccine (LAIV) using the ts/ca/att A/Ann Arbor/6/1960 backbone expressing HA and NA from H5N1 clades 2.3.4.4b, 2.3.2.1a, and 2.3.2.1e, and evaluated it in C57BL/6 mice.
analysis.methods: A single intranasal dose of the multivalent LAIV was administered to mice, and immune sera were assessed for cross-reactivity against clade-matched antigens; protection was evaluated after homologous lethal challenge.
analysis.main_results: Vaccinated mice showed robust humoral responses with broad cross-reactivity against all three H5N1 clades and were completely protected from disease following homologous challenge.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the findings as demonstrating the feasibility of a single-shot multivalent LAIV that expands antigenic coverage across antigenically distinct H5N1 lineages, representing a novel pan-H5N1 strategy.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results support advancing this multivalent LAIV as a broadly protective pan-H5N1 vaccine candidate for pandemic preparedness.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to a mouse model and lacks human data, which constrains generalizability and necessitates cautious interpretation of the strength of evidence.

analysis.summary_en: This study developed a one-shot multivalent live-attenuated influenza vaccine (LAIV) using a temperature-sensitive, cold-adapted A/Ann Arbor/6/1960 backbone expressing hemagglutinin and neuraminidase from three divergent H5N1 clades (2.3.4.4b, 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e). In C57BL/6 mice, a single intranasal immunization induced broadly cross-reactive neutralizing antibodies and conferred complete protection against homologous lethal challenge. The authors conclude that this multivalent LAIV strategy expands antigenic coverage within a single vaccine and demonstrates feasibility as a pan-H5N1 vaccine candidate for pandemic preparedness. However, the evidence is confined to a mouse model and lacks human data, limiting generalizability.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究满足了公共卫生对 疫苗 的迫切需求,该药物可以预防基因多样化的人畜共患 H5N1 流感病毒,这些病毒继续在多个分支中出现并构成大流行风险。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 作者使用表达 H5N1 进化枝 2.3.4.4b、2.3.2.1a 和 2.3.2.1e 的 HA 和 NA 的 ts/ca/att A/Ann Arbor/6/1960 主干开发了多价减毒活流感 疫苗 (LAIV),并在 C57BL/6 小鼠中进行了评估。

elements_zh.main_results: 接种疫苗的小鼠表现出强烈的体液反应,对所有三个 H5N1 进化枝具有广泛的交叉反应性,并且在同源攻击后完全免受疾病影响。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为证明了单次多价 LAIV 的可行性,该疫苗可以扩大抗原覆盖范围,覆盖不同抗原的 H5N1 谱系,代表了一种新的泛 H5N1 策略。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果支持将这种多价 LAIV 作为一种具有广泛保护性的泛 H5N1 疫苗 候选药物,用于大流行防范。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于小鼠模型,缺乏人类数据,这限制了普遍性,并且需要谨慎解释证据的强度。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 具有人畜共患潜力的遗传多样性高致病性 禽流感 (HPAI) H5N1 病毒的持续出现凸显了开发能够针对多个循环分支提供广泛保护的 疫苗 的迫切需要。在此,我们基于温度敏感 (ts)、冷适应 (ca) 和减毒 (att) 甲型/安娜堡/6/1960 主供体病毒 (MDV) 开发了一种一次性、多价、减毒活流感 疫苗 (LAIV),该病毒融合了来自代表性进化枝的血凝素 (HA) 和神经氨酸酶 (NA) 糖蛋白2.3.4.4b (A/Louisiana/12/2024)、2.3.2.1a (A/Victoria/149/2024) 和 2.3.2.1e (A/Cambodia/2302009/2023) H5N1 病毒。用多价 LAIV 对 C57BL/6 小鼠进行单次鼻内 (IN) 免疫,引发了强大的体液 免疫应答,免疫血清对 疫苗 中包含的所有三个 H5N1 进化枝的抗原表现出广泛的交叉反应性。经过同源病毒攻击后,接种疫苗的 C57BL/6 小鼠完全免受疾病侵害,证明了多价 LAIV 的免疫原性和保护功效。通过同时针对具有大流行潜力的抗原不同的 H5N1 谱系,该策略扩大了单个 LAIV 内的抗原覆盖范围,以确认泛 H5N1 保护。总之,这些发现支持这种多价 LAIV 的开发和实施,作为一种广泛保护性的泛 H5N1 LAIV,用于大流行防范。意义 人畜共患病 H5N1 病毒遗传多样性的增加使 疫苗 设计变得复杂。我们基于温度敏感、冷适应和减毒(ts、ca、att)主供体病毒(MDV)流感 A/Ann Arbor/6/1960 主链开发了多价减毒活流感 疫苗 (LAIV),该主链表达 H5N1 进化枝的血凝素 (HA) 和神经氨酸酶 (NA) 糖蛋白2.3.4.4b、2.3.2.1a 和 2.3.2.1e。使用多价 LAIV 进行单次鼻内 (IN) 免疫可诱导广泛的交叉反应性中和抗体 (NAb) 反应,并保护实验性疫苗接种动物免受同源致死病毒攻击,这证明多价 LAIV 可以预防人类最关心的 H5N1 病毒分支。这些发现证明了开发和实施这种多价 LAIV 作为人类使用的针对不同 H5N1 病毒的广泛保护性泛 H5N1 LAIV 的可行性。

papers.title: Deciphering viral action on host genome structure: a computational physics perspective.
papers.abstract: Recent experimental findings indicate that several viruses are able to substantially re-organize the host cell genome architecture. Since chromatin three-dimensional (3D) organization is tightly linked to vital cellular functions, investigating how viral infections impact physical mechanisms shaping DNA folding provides useful clues about virus action on gene regulation and consequent activation. This review provides an overview of recent advances in the development of computational modelling approaches used to shed light on how host cell chromatin 3D structure is altered following viral infections, including SARS-CoV-2 and avian influenza IAV-H5N1. Given the flexibility of this approach, such models can be adapted to a wide range of pathogens, making them valuable methods for investigating the specificity of distinct infection mechanisms. Overall, we show how such models can be helpful tools that, in tandem with traditional experimental methods, allow to decipher complexity of infection mechanisms at molecular level from a new perspective.

analysis.scope_and_question: This review focuses on avian influenza A viruses, specifically examining how these viruses alter the host cell genome structure through computational modeling approaches. The central question is how viral infections impact the physical mechanisms that shape DNA folding, offering insights into gene regulation and activation.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a systematic analysis of computational modeling approaches used to study the effects of avian influenza A viruses on host chromatin 3D structure. It includes studies on SARS-CoV-2 and avian influenza IAV-H5N1, highlighting the flexibility of these models in adapting to various pathogens.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that computational models are effective tools for understanding how avian influenza A viruses reorganize the host genome. These models, when combined with traditional experimental methods, provide a new perspective on deciphering the molecular complexity of infection mechanisms.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review acknowledges that while computational models offer valuable insights, they may not fully capture the nuances of viral interactions with host DNA. analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that further research should focus on refining computational models to better reflect the biological specificity of avian influenza subtypes. It also emphasizes the importance of integrating these models with experimental data to improve understanding and inform public health strategies.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) continues to cause substantial mortality in poultry and wild birds globally [1,2]. The study aimed to investigate whether the seasonality of HPAI is changing over time.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed global HPAI surveillance data from multiple regions to assess seasonal patterns. It included data from poultry and wild bird populations across different geographic locations.
analysis.methods: The researchers reviewed and analyzed HPAI surveillance data to identify seasonal trends. They compared historical data with recent observations to determine if there was a shift in seasonality.
analysis.main_results: Previously, HPAI showed marked winter seasonality.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors suggest that the observed changes in seasonality may indicate a shift in the epidemiology of HPAI, potentially affecting surveillance and control strategies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings may inform the development of more effective surveillance and response strategies for HPAI outbreaks, particularly in regions where seasonal patterns are changing.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on historical data and does not include detailed statistical analysis, which may limit the confidence in its conclusions. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the observational nature of the analysis.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates whether the seasonality of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) is changing globally. It reviews historical and recent surveillance data to assess seasonal patterns in poultry and wild bird populations. The results indicate that HPAI previously showed marked winter seasonality, but there is a suggestion of a shift in its epidemiology. The authors interpret this as a potential change in the virus's behavior, which could have implications for surveillance and control strategies. However, the study's reliance on observational data without detailed statistical analysis limits the confidence in its conclusions, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 高致病性禽流感 (HPAI) 继续在家禽中造成大量 死亡率,并在全球范围内造成 野生鸟类 [1,2]。该研究旨在调查高致病性禽流感的季节性是否随时间而变化。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了来自多个地区的全球 HPAI 监测 数据,以评估季节性模式。它包括来自不同地理位置的家禽和 野生鸟类 种群的数据。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员审查并分析了 HPAI 监测 数据,以确定季节性趋势。他们将历史数据与最近的观察结果进行比较,以确定是否存在季节性变化。
elements_zh.main_results: 此前,HPAI表现出明显的冬季季节性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,观察到的季节性变化可能表明 HPAI 的 流行病学 发生了变化,可能会影响 监测 和控制策略。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能有助于制定更有效的 监测 和 HPAI 暴发 应对策略,特别是在季节性模式发生变化的地区。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于历史数据,不包括详细的统计分析,这可能会限制其结论的可信度。由于分析的观察性质,证据的强度中等。

papers.title: Immunization with deglycosylated H7N9 VLP enhances cross-strain protective antibody responses against avian influenza H7N9 variants in mice
papers.abstract: Introduction The rapidly evolving avian influenza H7N9 virus remains a threaten to public health globally. There is an urgent need to develop broad-spectrum vaccines capable of eliciting functional cross-strain protective immunity against emerging viral variants. Methods N-linked glycosylation can shield critical residues from immune recognition. Here, a prototype virus-like particle (VLP) was constructed based on the antigenic sequences derived from A/Taiwan/1/2013 H7N9 virus. Glycosidase enzymes were utilized to trim the glycan molecules for generating monoglycosylated VLP (VLPmg) and nonglycosylated VLP (VLPng) derivates. The structural integrity, antigenicity, and immunogenicity of these VLPs were systematically evaluated. Results Both VLPmg and VLPng maintained hemagglutination activity and antigenicity like the fully glycosylated prototype VLP (VLPfg). papers.abstract_zh: 简介 快速进化的 禽流感 H7N9 病毒仍然对全球公共卫生构成威胁。迫切需要开发广谱 疫苗,能够引发针对新出现的病毒变种的功能性跨毒株保护性免疫。方法 N-连接糖基化可以保护关键残基免受免疫识别。在这里,基于 A/Taiwan/1/2013 H7N9 病毒的抗原序列构建了原型病毒样颗粒 (VLP)。利用糖苷酶修剪聚糖分子,以生成单糖基化 VLP (VLPmg) 和非糖基化 VLP (VLPng) 衍生物。对这些 VLP 的结构完整性、抗原性和免疫原性进行了系统评估。结果 VLPmg 和 VLPng 均保持与完全糖基化原型 VLP (VLPfg) 一样的血凝活性和抗原性。用去糖基化的 VLP 进行免疫可以在小鼠体内诱导出强大的病毒特异性抗体和平衡的 Th1/Th2 免疫特征,而滴度与 VLPfg 相当。其中,VLPng针对不同的H7N9病毒株诱导了更高的血凝抑制和中和抗体滴度,表明跨病毒株反应性抗体反应得到改善。结论 这项研究表明,流感 H7N9 VLP 的酶促去糖基化可改善小鼠体内广泛保护性抗体反应的诱导。非糖基化的 H7N9 VLP 代表了潜在的 疫苗 候选药物,可对抗抗原不同的 H7N9 病毒变种的威胁。

papers.title: CD4 + T-cell responses directed towards A/H5N1-derived haemagglutinin peptides increase in patients with seasonal influenza A virus infection.
papers.abstract: Abstract Objectives Recent outbreak of influenza A/H5N1 viral infections in birds and mammals worldwide prompted renewed concerns over an emerging H5N1‐related influenza pandemic in the generally immunologically‐naive global population. Cross‐reactive CD4+ T cells between A/H1N1 and A/H5N1 subtypes targeting internal and surface influenza proteins have been identified in humans, indicating some protection against severe and fatal A/H5N1 infection. Methods To detect T‐cell responses towards H1 and H5 viruses, we stimulated PBMCs from patients hospitalised with seasonal influenza A viruses, alongside healthy individuals, with overlapping peptide pools spanning hemagglutinin (HA) and neuraminidase (NA) of A/Vietnam/1203/2004 (H5N1) and A/New York/18/2009 (H1N1‐pdm09‐like) viruses. Results Majority of acutely infected and healthy participants (100% and 75%, respectively) had detectable CD4+ and CD8+ T‐cell responses towards H1‐HA and H5‐HA, whereas 30–80% of individuals had detectable H5‐NA responses. H1 and H5 HA‐specific CD4+ T‐cell responses highly correlated, suggesting some level of cross‐reactivity between T‐cell responses directed against H1 and H5 subtypes. HA‐specific CD4+ T‐cell responses were increased in influenza patients compared to healthy participants. We found no differences in H1‐ and H5‐specific T cell responses between those born pre‐ and post‐1968, irrespective of infection status. Sequence alignment of H1 and H5 viruses identified high conservation in the HA2 stalk subunit (81.53%). CD4+ T‐cell immunity towards immunodominant HA306–318 epitope, restricted by several HLA‐DRB1 molecules, revealed limited cross‐reactivity between Group 1 and Group 2 HA‐subtypes. Conclusion We define correlative H1‐ and H5‐specific CD4+ T‐cell responses during seasonal influenza A virus infection, likely reflecting some level of H1/H5 T cell cross‐reactivity.

Methods To detect T‐cell responses towards H1 and H5 viruses, we stimulated PBMCs from patients hospitalised with seasonal influenza A viruses, alongside healthy individuals, with overlapping peptide pools spanning hemagglutinin (HA) and neuraminidase (NA) of A/Vietnam/1203/2004 (H5N1) and A/New York/18/2009 (H1N1‐pdm09‐like) viruses. Results Majority of acutely infected and healthy participants (100% and 75%, respectively) had detectable CD4+ and CD8+ T‐cell responses towards H1‐HA and H5‐HA, whereas 30–80% of individuals had detectable H5‐NA responses. H1 and H5 HA‐specific CD4+ T‐cell responses highly correlated, suggesting some level of cross‐reactivity between T‐cell responses directed against H1 and H5 subtypes. HA‐specific CD4+ T‐cell responses were increased in influenza patients compared to healthy participants. We found no differences in H1‐ and H5‐specific T cell responses between those born pre‐ and post‐1968, irrespective of infection status. Sequence alignment of H1 and H5 viruses identified high conservation in the HA2 stalk subunit (81.53%). CD4+ T‐cell immunity towards immunodominant HA306–318 epitope, restricted by several HLA‐DRB1 molecules, revealed limited cross‐reactivity between Group 1 and Group 2 HA‐subtypes. Conclusion We define correlative H1‐ and H5‐specific CD4+ T‐cell responses during seasonal influenza A virus infection, likely reflecting some level of H1/H5 T cell cross‐reactivity.
papers.title_original: CD4 + T-cell responses directed towards A/H5N1-derived haemagglutinin peptides increase in patients with seasonal influenza A virus infection.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed whether cross-reactive CD4+ T-cell responses exist between seasonal influenza A/H1N1 and avian A/H5N1 viruses in humans, motivated by global concerns over potential H5N1 pandemics in immunologically naive populations following recent outbreaks in birds and mammals.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study enrolled patients hospitalized with seasonal influenza A virus infection and healthy individuals, collecting peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) to assess T-cell responses against hemagglutinin (HA) and neuraminidase (NA) peptides from A/H5N1 and A/H1N1 viruses.
analysis.methods: Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) were stimulated with overlapping peptide pools spanning HA and NA proteins from A/Vietnam/1203/2004 (H5N1) and A/New York/18/2009 (H1N1-pdm09-like) viruses to detect CD4+ and CD8+ T-cell responses using standard immunological assays.
analysis.main_results: All acutely infected participants and 75% of healthy participants had detectable CD4+ and CD8+ T-cell responses to H1-HA and H5-HA, while 30–80% showed detectable H5-NA responses; HA-specific CD4+ T-cell responses were higher in influenza patients than in healthy participants.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the strong correlation between H1- and H5-HA-specific CD4+ T-cell responses as evidence of cross-reactivity, noting high conservation in the HA2 stalk subunit (81.53%) and limited cross-reactivity at the immunodominant HA306–318 epitope across HA subtypes.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that pre-existing CD4+ T-cell immunity from seasonal influenza may provide partial protection against severe H5N1 infection, informing future vaccine strategies targeting conserved HA regions to broaden influenza immunity.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated cross-reactive CD4+ T-cell responses between seasonal influenza A/H1N1 and avian A/H5N1 viruses in humans, prompted by global concerns over potential H5N1 pandemics. The evidence is moderate due to small sample size, absence of direct H5N1 infection cases, and reliance on in vitro assays.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 目的 最近全球范围内鸟类和哺乳动物中发生的 A/H5N1 流感病毒感染事件再次引发人们对在全球普遍免疫学上未接受过免疫的人群中出现的新出现的 H5N1 相关流感大流行的担忧。已在人类体内发现了针对内部和表面流感蛋白的 A/H1N1 和 A/H5N1 亚型之间的交叉反应性 CD4+ T 细胞,这表明对严重和致命的 A/H5N1 感染有一定的保护作用。方法 为了检测针对 H1 和 H5 病毒的 T 细胞反应,我们刺激了因季节性甲型流感病毒住院的患者以及健康个体的 PBMC,其中包含 A/Vietnam/1203/2004 (H5N1) 和 A/New York/18/2009(H1N1-pdm09-like)病毒的血凝素 (HA) 和神经氨酸酶 (NA) 重叠肽库。结果 大多数急性感染者和健康参与者(分别为 100% 和 75%)对 H1-HA 和 H5-HA 具有可检测到的 CD4+ 和 CD8+ T 细胞反应,而 30-80% 的个体具有可检测到的 H5-NA 反应。H1 和 H5 HA 特异性 CD4+ T 细胞反应高度相关,表明针对 H1 和 H5 亚型的 T 细胞反应之间存在一定程度的交叉反应。与健康参与者相比,流感患者的 HA 特异性 CD4+ T 细胞反应增强。我们发现,无论感染状态如何,1968 年之前和之后出生的人的 H1 和 H5 特异性 T 细胞反应没有差异。H1 和 H5 病毒的序列比对发现 HA2 茎亚基具有高度保守性 (81.53%)。CD4+ T 细胞对免疫显性 HA306-318 表位的免疫,受到几个 HLA-DRB1 分子的限制,揭示了第 1 组和第 2 组 HA 亚型之间有限的交叉反应性。结论 我们定义了季节性甲型流感病毒感染期间相关的 H1 和 H5 特异性 CD4+ T 细胞反应,可能反映了一定程度的 H1/H5 T 细胞交叉反应性。

papers.title: Spatio-temporal Modelling of H5N1 Avian Influenza Outbreaks in Europe (2021-2024)
papers.abstract: Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI), particularly the H5N1 strain, poses a significant ongoing threat to animal health, biodiversity and food security across Europe. Understanding where and when avian influenza risks intensify is essential for targeted surveillance and rapid response. This study develops a data-driven spatio-temporal framework that integrates geospatial, ecological and climatic datasets to explain and forecast the dynamics of H5N1 outbreaks between 2021 and 2024. Weekly country-level outbreak counts (208 weeks, 37 countries) were analysed using a hierarchical endemic-epidemic model with an assumption of Negative Binomial distribution. Environmental covariates, bird-species densities, and human population metrics were incorporated into endemic and autoregressive components. Model performance was evaluated using rolling one-step-ahead forecasts assessed by proper scoring rules (logarithmic score and ranked probability score) and calibration diagnostics. The proposed framework substantially outperformed a regression-only Negative Binomial baseline, reducing mean logS by approximately 29% and RPS by 49%, while exhibiting improved probabilistic calibration. Results indicate that H5N1 transmission is structured by ecological drivers and local persistence mechanisms rather than purely seasonal effects. Anseriformes, Charadriiformes and Pelecaniformes densities were identified as the key migratory bird families contributing to the viral spread. The endemic-epidemic model achieved high forecast accuracy, with majority of the of observed weekly outbreak counts falling within central predictive intervals (RPS = 0.76, logS = 0.61). Overall, the proposed framework provides a scalable approach for integrating ecological and spatial information into early-warning systems for HPAI surveillance.

The framework offers a scalable approach for early-warning systems in HPAI surveillance, though reliance on aggregated data and model assumptions limits generalisability and evidence strength to moderate.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究开发了一个数据驱动的时空框架,整合了地理空间、生态和气候数据集,利用 37 个国家在 208 周内的每周国家级 暴发 计数来解释和预测 2021 年至 2024 年欧洲的 H5N1 暴发。

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 所提出的框架提供了一种可扩展的方法,用于将生态和空间信息整合到 HPAI 监测 预警系统中,从而能够更精确地定位 监测 和响应工作。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于国家层面的汇总数据和模型框架,该框架可能无法捕捉精细尺度的 传播 动态,从而限制了对当地情况的普遍适用性,并将证据强度限制为中等。

papers.title: Comparative Immunogenicity of Inactivated H7N9 Avian Influenza Vaccines with Different Internal Gene Backbones
papers.abstract: H7N9 avian influenza virus (AIV) poses a persistent threat to poultry and public health. Despite widespread vaccination in China, rapid antigenic drift and reassortment necessitate frequent updates of vaccine strains. Phylogenetic analysis of isolates from Chinese provinces (from 2019 to 2023) showed that while surface genes diversified, the internal gene cassette remained conserved yet actively reassorted with other subtypes, suggesting internal gene compatibility may influence vaccine performance. We selected the H7N9 strain A/chicken/Northeast China/19854-6/2019 (E2), which harbors a polybasic Hemagglutinin (HA) cleavage site and predicted dual receptor-binding affinity. To enable safe vaccine development, we modified the HA cleavage site to generate a low-pathogenicity strain (E2-Δ). Using reverse genetics, we constructed three recombinant viruses: E2-Δ (retaining contemporary internal genes), CVI-E2, and CVII-E2 (containing internal genes from commercially used donor strains CVI and CVII, respectively). Inactivated vaccines were evaluated in specific-pathogen-free (SPF) chickens. E2-Δ induced HI antibody titers comparable to those of CVI-E2 and significantly higher than those of CVII-E2, and showed modestly higher cross-reactive HI titers against some recent H7N9 variants in exploratory analyses. All vaccines provided complete homologous protection with reduced viral shedding and no clinical signs in challenge trials. Our findings suggest that internal gene backbone compatibility may influence vaccine immunogenicity. While E2-Δ outperformed CVII-E2, it was comparable to CVI-E2, indicating that certain traditional backbones may still be suitable for H7N9 vaccine development. analysis.research_question_and_background: H7N9 avian influenza virus (AIV) remains a public-health threat and poultry challenge despite vaccination campaigns, with antigenic drift and reassortment driving the need for updated vaccine strains.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study constructed three inactivated H7N9 vaccines differing by internal gene backbones and evaluated immunogenicity and protection in specific-pathogen-free (SPF) chickens.
analysis.methods: Reverse genetics generated E2-Δ (low-pathogenicity HA cleavage site variant) and two recombinants (CVI-E2 and CVII-E2) with contemporary or donor-strain internal genes; inactivated vaccines were prepared and tested.
analysis.main_results: E2-Δ induced hemagglutination-inhibition (HI) titers comparable to CVI-E2 and higher than CVII-E2, with modestly higher cross-reactive HI titers against some recent H7N9 variants; all vaccines provided complete homologous protection and reduced viral shedding without clinical signs.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that internal gene backbone compatibility influences vaccine immunogenicity, noting E2-Δ’s superiority over CVII-E2 yet parity with CVI-E2, and propose this strategy for refining H7N9 vaccine design.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings suggest that selecting internal gene backbones compatible with circulating surface antigens may improve H7N9 vaccine performance and support broader avian influenza vaccine strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to an abstract-only report in SPF chickens, lacks human data, and does not quantify cross-protection or statistical significance, warranting cautious interpretation and further validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study addressed the need for improved H7N9 avian influenza vaccines by comparing three inactivated vaccines with different internal gene backbones in SPF chickens. Using reverse genetics, the authors generated E2-Δ (a low-pathogenicity variant) and two recombinants (CVI-E2 and CVII-E2) incorporating contemporary or donor-strain internal genes. E2-Δ elicited hemagglutination-inhibition titers comparable to CVI-E2 and higher than CVII-E2, with modestly higher cross-reactivity against recent H7N9 variants. All vaccines conferred complete homologous protection and reduced viral shedding without clinical signs. The authors conclude that internal gene backbone compatibility influences immunogenicity, with E2-Δ outperforming CVII-E2 but matching CVI-E2, supporting refined vaccine design strategies for H7N9 and potentially other avian influenza subtypes. However, the evidence is limited to an abstract-only report in chickens and lacks human validation or statistical detail.

papers.abstract_zh: H7N9 禽流感 病毒 (AIV) 对家禽和公共卫生构成持续威胁。尽管疫苗接种在中国广泛传播,但快速的抗原漂移和重配使得疫苗毒株的频繁更新成为必要。对中国各省分离株(2019年至2023年)的系统发育分析表明,虽然表面基因多样化,但内部基因盒仍然保守,但与其他亚型积极重配,表明内部基因兼容性可能影响疫苗的性能。我们选择了 H7N9 毒株 A/鸡/中国东北/19854-6/2019 (E2),其具有多元血凝素 (HA) 裂解位点并预测了双重受体结合亲和力。为了实现 疫苗 的安全开发,我们修改了 HA 裂解位点以生成低致病性菌株 (E2-Δ)。利用反向遗传学,我们构建了三种重组病毒:E2-Δ(保留当代内部基因)、CVI-E2和CVII-E2(分别包含来自商业使用的供体菌株CVI和CVII的内部基因)。在无特定病原体 (SPF) 鸡中评估了灭活的 疫苗。E2-Δ 诱导的 HI 抗体滴度与 CVI-E2 相当,并且显着高于 CVII-E2,并且在探索性分析中针对最近的一些 H7N9 变种表现出略高的交叉反应 HI 滴度。所有 疫苗 均提供完整的同源保护,减少病毒脱落,并且在挑战试验中没有临床症状。我们的研究结果表明,内部基因主链兼容性可能会影响 疫苗 的免疫原性。虽然 E2-Δ 的性能优于 CVII-E2,但与 CVI-E2 相当,表明某些传统骨架可能仍然适合 H7N9 疫苗 的开发。这种方法需要进一步验证,以支持 H7N9 和潜在其他 禽流感 亚型的改进 疫苗 设计策略。

analysis_zh.methods: 反向遗传学产生了 E2-Δ(低致病性 HA 裂解位点变体)和两个具有当代或供体菌株内部基因的重组体(CVI-E2 和 CVII-E2);制备并测试了灭活的疫苗。
analysis_zh.main_results: E2-Δ 诱导的血凝抑制 (HI) 滴度与 CVI-E2 相当,高于 CVII-E2,并且针对一些最近的 H7N9 变种的交叉反应 HI 滴度略高;所有 疫苗 均提供完全同源保护并减少病毒脱落,且无临床症状。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,内部基因主链兼容性影响 疫苗 免疫原性,指出 E2-Δ 优于 CVII-E2,但与 CVI-E2 相当,并提出了这种改进 H7N9 疫苗 设计的策略。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,选择与循环表面抗原兼容的内部基因主链可能会改善 H7N9 疫苗 性能并支持更广泛的 禽流感 疫苗 策略。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于 SPF 鸡的摘要报告,缺乏人类数据,并且没有量化交叉保护或统计显着性,需要谨慎解释和进一步验证。

papers.title: High pathogenicity avian influenza A (H5N1) viruses isolated from poultry and wild birds in Japan during the 2024–2025 season
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT H5N1 high pathogenicity avian influenza (HPAI) viruses of clade 2.3.4.4b continue to spread globally among wild birds and poultry, and diversify through gene reassortment. Since 2024, spillovers of H5N1 viruses have been reported in dairy cattle in the United States. Given the numerous HPAI outbreaks in poultry and wild birds in Japan during the 2024–2025 season, we aimed to examine the genetic diversity, pathogenicity, and host range of these viruses. Phylogenetic analyses revealed that all viruses in the 2024–2025 season belonged to G2d and G2c subgroups in clade 2.3.4.4b and were divided into 11 genotypes (G2d: six genotypes, G2c: five genotypes). Of these, G2d-0 was the dominant genotype in both poultry and wild birds. Novel genotypes emerged through reassortment between G2d and G2c viruses. Experimental infection of chickens revealed comparable pathogenicity among genotypes, although the amounts of viral shedding were high in chickens inoculated with G2d-0 and G2c-13 viruses, which were genotypes confirmed in multiple outbreaks in the 2024–2025 season, suggesting high transmission potential. In vitro assays revealed markedly lower infectivity of Japanese isolates in bovine mammary epithelial cells compared with that of the B3.13 genotype responsible for dairy cattle outbreaks in the United States, indicating limited risk of cattle infection. Together, these findings underscore ongoing genetic diversification of HPAI viruses in G2d and G2c subgroups and highlight the importance of continued in vivo and in vitro characterization of these viruses to monitor changes in genotypes, pathogenicity, and potential risk of spillover to cattle. IMPORTANCE H5N1 high pathogenicity avian influenza (HPAI) viruses have spread in poultry and wild birds worldwide. H5N1 viruses have also spread in dairy cattle in the United States since 2024. Japan reported numerous HPAI cases during the 2024–2025 season. Herein, phylogenetic analyses using strains isolated from poultry and wild birds enabled a detailed investigation of their genetic backgrounds, which is essential for elucidating introduction routes and evolution. Investigation of pathogenicity may help predict the outbreak frequency. This study revealed that HPAI viruses of multiple genotypes had been introduced into Japan, and chickens infected with genotypes detected from continuous outbreaks exhibited high virus shedding. In addition, comparing infectivity in bovine cells revealed the risk of cattle infection. H5N1 infection had not been reported in cattle in Japan, and our results suggest that the risk remains low. These integrated analyses provide key insights for developing effective strategies against HPAI outbreaks.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究探讨了分支 2.3.4.4b 的 H5N1 高致病性 禽流感 (HPAI) 病毒在 野生鸟类 和家禽中的持续全球传播和多样化,以及自 2024 年以来在美国奶牛中最近出现的 跨物种溢出。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究检查了 2024-2025 年季节从日本家禽和 野生鸟类 中分离出的 HPAI 病毒,重点关注遗传多样性、致病性和 宿主 范围。
elements_zh.methods: 进行系统发育分析以确定遗传背景和亚组分类,并通过鸡的实验感染评估致病性和病毒脱落。体外测定评估了牛乳腺上皮细胞的感染性。
elements_zh.main_results: 所有病毒均属于进化枝2.3.4.4b中的G2d和G2c亚组,分为11个基因型(6个G2d和5个G2c)。G2d-0 是家禽和 野生鸟类 中的显性基因型。接种 G2d-0 和 G2c-13 的鸡表现出较高的病毒脱落率,表明 传播 潜力较高。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,新的基因型是通过 G2d 和 G2c 病毒之间的重配出现的,并且日本牛感染的风险仍然较低,因为与美国奶牛 暴发 的 B3.13 基因型相比,日本分离株在牛细胞中的感染性明显较低。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了日本 HPAI 病毒持续的遗传多样性,并强调需要持续进行 监测 和表征,以监测基因型、致病性和对牛的潜在 跨物种溢出 风险的变化。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其依赖于系统发育和实验数据,没有日本牛感染的直接证据,而且仅抽象的证据限制了对方法和结果的详细评估,需要进行适度的置信度评估。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究探讨了分支 2.3.4.4b 的 H5N1 高致病性 禽流感 (HPAI) 病毒在 野生鸟类 和家禽中的持续全球传播和多样化,以及自 2024 年以来在美国奶牛中最近出现的 跨物种溢出。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究检查了 2024-2025 年季节从日本家禽和 野生鸟类 中分离出的 HPAI 病毒,重点关注遗传多样性、致病性和 宿主 范围。
analysis_zh.methods: 进行系统发育分析以确定遗传背景和亚组分类,并通过鸡的实验感染评估致病性和病毒脱落。体外测定评估了牛乳腺上皮细胞的感染性。
analysis_zh.main_results: 所有病毒均属于进化枝2.3.4.4b中的G2d和G2c亚组,分为11个基因型(6个G2d和5个G2c)。G2d-0 是家禽和 野生鸟类 中的显性基因型。接种 G2d-0 和 G2c-13 的鸡表现出较高的病毒脱落率,表明 传播 潜力较高。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,新的基因型是通过 G2d 和 G2c 病毒之间的重配出现的,并且日本牛感染的风险仍然较低,因为与美国奶牛 暴发 的 B3.13 基因型相比,日本分离株在牛细胞中的感染性明显较低。

analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其依赖于系统发育和实验数据,没有日本牛感染的直接证据,而且仅抽象的证据限制了对方法和结果的详细评估,需要进行适度的置信度评估。

papers.title: Avian influenza risk mapping in India using machine learning
papers.abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) remains a recurrent threat to poultry production and One-Health surveillance in India. We developed a national relative spatial risk map for India using curated outbreak records spanning January 2006 to April 2024 (predominantly HPAI H5N1 and H5N8), buffered pseudo-absence sampling, H3 resolution-7 hexagons, and 94 environmental, livestock, land-cover, and anthropogenic predictors. Under 5-fold spatial block cross-validation, eight base classifiers were trained and all performed above chance (AUC > 0.76). The Gaussian-process stacked meta-learner achieved the highest AUC (0.853), but the improvement over the strongest individual base learner, Random Forest (AUC 0.851; Brier 0.155; ECE 0.079), was small and statistically non-significant. Its principal added value was a companion uncertainty layer, the GPR posterior standard deviation, which showed internal consistency with ensemble disagreement across base models ( r = 0.74, p < 0.001). Feature attribution ranked human population density, extensive chicken density, June precipitation, and seasonal humidity variables among the predictors most associated with model outputs, with interpretation constrained by passive-surveillance bias and multicollinearity. The resulting relative spatial risk surface, prediction-uncertainty surface, and subdistrict risk-uncertainty classification layers identify eastern, northeastern, coastal, and selected southern regions as priorities for targeted surveillance and prospective validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to address the recurring threat of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) to poultry production and One-Health surveillance in India. A national relative spatial risk map was developed using outbreak records from January 2006 to April 2024, incorporating 94 environmental, livestock, land-cover, and anthropogenic predictors. The study employed 5-fold spatial block cross-validation with eight base classifiers, all performing above chance. The Gaussian-process stacked meta-learner achieved the highest AUC (0.853), but the improvement over the strongest base learner, Random Forest, was small and non-significant. The principal added value was an uncertainty layer showing internal consistency with ensemble disagreement. The findings highlight eastern, northeastern, coastal, and selected southern regions as priorities for targeted surveillance. The study's implications suggest that human population density, extensive chicken density, June precipitation, and seasonal humidity are key predictors, though interpretation is constrained by passive-surveillance bias and multicollinearity. The evidence strength is moderate, with no specific limitations reported.

papers.title_zh: 禽流感 使用机器学习在印度绘制风险地图
papers.source_body_en: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) remains a recurrent threat to poultry production and One-Health surveillance in India. We developed a national relative spatial risk map for India using curated outbreak records spanning January 2006 to April 2024 (predominantly HPAI H5N1 and H5N8), buffered pseudo-absence sampling, H3 resolution-7 hexagons, and 94 environmental, livestock, land-cover, and anthropogenic predictors. Under 5-fold spatial block cross-validation, eight base classifiers were trained and all performed above chance (AUC > 0.76). The Gaussian-process stacked meta-learner achieved the highest AUC (0.853), but the improvement over the strongest individual base learner, Random Forest (AUC 0.851; Brier 0.155; ECE 0.079), was small and statistically non-significant. Its principal added value was a companion uncertainty layer, the GPR posterior standard deviation, which showed internal consistency with ensemble disagreement across base models ( r = 0.74, p < 0.001). Feature attribution ranked human population density, extensive chicken density, June precipitation, and seasonal humidity variables among the predictors most associated with model outputs, with interpretation constrained by passive-surveillance bias and multicollinearity. The resulting relative spatial risk surface, prediction-uncertainty surface, and subdistrict risk-uncertainty classification layers identify eastern, northeastern, coastal, and selected southern regions as priorities for targeted surveillance and prospective validation.
papers.abstract_zh: 高致病性禽流感 (HPAI) 仍然对印度的家禽生产和 One-Health 监测 构成经常性威胁。我们使用 2006 年 1 月至 2024 年 4 月精选的 暴发 记录(主要是 HPAI H5N1 和 H5N8)、缓冲伪缺失采样、H3 分辨率 7 六边形以及 94 个环境、牲畜、土地覆盖和人为预测因子,开发了印度国家相对空间风险地图。在 5 倍空间块交叉验证下,训练了 8 个基本分类器,并且所有分类器的表现都高于机会 (AUC > 0.76)。高斯过程堆叠元学习器实现了最高的 AUC(0.853),但相对于最强的个体基础学习器随机森林(AUC 0.851;Brier 0.155;ECE 0.079)的改进很小,并且在统计上不显着。它的主要附加值是一个伴随的不确定性层,即 GPR 后标准差,它显示出基本模型之间的集合分歧的内部一致性(r = 0.74,p < 0.001)。特征归因将人口密度、粗养鸡密度、六月降水量和季节性湿度变量列为与模型输出最相关的预测变量,其解释受到被动 监测 偏差和多重共线性的限制。由此产生的相对空间风险面、预测不确定性面和分区风险不确定性分类层将东部、东北部、沿海和选定的南部地区确定为目标 监测 和前瞻性验证的优先事项。

papers.title: Newton Divided Difference Optimization for Fingerprint-Based Neural Virtual Screening against Avian Influenza A/H9N2
papers.abstract: Avian influenza A/H9N2 poses persistent zoonotic and veterinary threats, yet efficient computational tools for antiviral compound prioritization remain underdeveloped, particularly with respect to optimizer behavior in high-dimensional neural screening. This study proposes Newton Divided Difference (NDD) optimization, a lightweight positive diagonal curvature-aware training strategy, as a novel optimizer for fingerprint-based neural virtual screening against avian influenza A/H9N2, with the objective of evaluating its performance across aligned molecular fingerprint representations and chemically structured validation protocols. An aligned benchmark of 1,459 molecules consisting of 615 candidate active compounds and 844 decoys was represented by EState (79 features), PubChem (881 features), and Klekota–Roth (4,860 features) fingerprints, sharing identical molecule identities, labels, and split assignments. A fixed multilayer perceptron (MLP) classifier was trained with NDD and seven baseline optimizers under stratified, scaffold-key, and similarity-cluster split protocols across five repeated seeds. NDD achieved the highest descriptive ROC-AUC (Receiver Operating Characteriztic – Area Under the Curve) and PR-AUC (Precision-Recall Area Under the Curve) on Klekota–Roth fingerprints under scaffold-key and similarity-cluster protocols, and remained competitive under the stratified split with ROC-AUC of 0.9872. Architecture-sensitivity tests confirmed stable NDD performance across multiple network configurations, with ROC-AUC values ranging from 0.9876 to 0.9890. Compared with Hessian-free optimization, NDD reduced per-run runtime from approximately 50–54 seconds to approximately 8 seconds on Klekota–Roth under the same CPU-only configuration while achieving comparable ranking performance. The novelty of this work lies in the first systematic assessment of NDD for H9N2 neural virtual screening, demonstrating that positive diagonal curvature-aware scaling provides a practical, stable, and computationally efficient optimization alternative in sparse high-dimensional ligand-based screening settings, although external validation and prospective experimental confirmation remain necessary before practical antiviral prioritization.
